patch_description: The previous edit added a mid-layer RY refresh (4 extra params) but this *decreased* combined score (0.63→0.62) and increased the generalization gap (0.09→0.10), indicating those extra single-qubit rotations added capacity without adding useful entangling structure. This edit reverts that regression by removing the mid-layer RY block, and instead invests the parameter budget more effectively by adding two three-qubit ZZZ interactions (which have no wire-pair restrictions) that link the hub qubit 0 with the two secondary clusters (qubits 4,8 and qubits 5,7). These gates share a single parameter to keep the parameter count low while introducing genuine higher-order (three-body) correlations that the existing two-qubit CRZ backbone cannot capture. Net effect versus the current program: -4 params (mid-layer RY removed) +1 param (shared ZZZ) = -3 params, while adding two three-qubit entangling gates that should improve expressivity/generalization without ballooning the parameter count.
